title: Mover summary file (schema version 1)
description: movers.json. One file for the whole release, so the Today tab can rank movers and decreases for any area without a request that reveals the user's area. The pipeline computes every figure with the versioned rule below, and the app never recomputes it. Only a series with an observed latest value and an observed previous value appears here, and a superseded series never does.

ruleVersion.description: Names the deterministic rule that computed every percentChange in the file, so each figure stays traceable.

latestPeriod.description: Later than previousPeriod, in the same form. JSON Schema cannot compare the two, so build/validate_schemas.py does.

previousValue.description: Above zero, because percentChange divides by it.

percentChange.description: (latestValue / previousValue - 1) × 100 in percent, so 2.5 means a 2.5 percent increase. The value is not rounded.
